_about: Pins the TypeScript failure classes (src/contexts/learning) against bash classify_failure (scripts/lib/daemon-failure.sh) for the classes W2-04 maps. 'bash' is the label bash returned for the text; 'ts' is the TS class. 'differs' documents a deliberate mismatch on a mapped class. Regenerate the bash column by sourcing daemon-failure.sh with LOG_DIR set and calling classify_failure per text.
